business.description: Business-friendly content for SME owners and managers

title.description: Concise, human-friendly title (max 80 chars) focused on business risk. Example: 'Outdated JavaScript Library Enables Service Disruption'

summary.description: 2-3 sentence plain-English summary of what this vulnerability means for the business

impact.description: Business impact explanation: revenue, reputation, compliance, customer trust implications

urgency.description: How urgently the business should prioritize this fix

actions.description: 2-4 actionable steps the business owner can take or delegate

blog_slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the business blog post. Example: 'outdated-jquery-library-risk'

technical.description: Technical remediation content for developers and IT contractors

title.description: Technical title describing the vulnerability. Example: 'jQuery 1.x XSS via Selector Injection (CVE-2020-11022)'

vulnerability_explanation.description: Technical explanation of the vulnerability mechanism and attack vector

root_cause.description: Root cause analysis — why this vulnerability exists in the first place

impact.description: Technical impact: what an attacker can achieve (RCE, data exfiltration, session hijacking, etc.)

level.description: Severity level based on exploitability and impact

cvss_estimate.description: Estimated CVSS range (e.g., '7.0-8.0'), or null if unknown

justification.description: Brief justification for the severity rating

affected_components.description: Affected components with their vulnerable version ranges (e.g., ['jQuery < 3.5.0', 'Bootstrap < 3.4.1', 'OpenSSL 1.0.x - 1.0.2h']). Each entry pairs a component name with the specific versions affected. Use 'all versions' if every version is vulnerable.

verification_steps.description: Steps to verify the fix was applied correctly

code_examples.description: Code examples showing vulnerable and fixed versions, or null if not applicable (e.g., infrastructure/config findings)

vulnerable.description: Example of vulnerable code or configuration, or null if not applicable

fixed.description: Example of the fixed code or configuration, or null if not applicable

language.description: Programming language or config format of the examples, or null if no code examples

best_practices.description: Security best practices to prevent similar issues

references.description: Relevant URLs: CVE entries, vendor advisories, OWASP pages. Null if no references found.

blog_slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the technical blog post. Example: 'remediating-jquery-xss-cve-2020-11022'

metadata.description: Structured metadata for filtering and categorization

components.description: Affected components or technologies (e.g., ['jQuery', 'JavaScript', 'Frontend']), or null if not applicable

owasp_category.description: Most relevant OWASP Top 10 2025 category (e.g., 'A03' for Injection)

estimated_effort.description: Estimated effort to implement the fix

is_exploitable.description: Whether this is realistically exploitable in a typical deployment
